candidates.description: This vector represents academic degrees, higher education, and titles associated with scholarship and academic professionals.
This vector represents academic titles, medical professionals, and related terms associated with advanced degrees and practitioners.
The feature represents two-letter capitalized abbreviations or initials, commonly used for proper names, acronyms, or codes.
This feature vector represents higher education institutions and academic environments.
This feature activates on concepts, terminology, and institutions related to learning, schooling, and academic environments.
This vector activates for technical, scientific, and academic disciplines as well as their related roots, abbreviations, and methodology terms.
This vector represents academic titles, prefixes, and scholarly terms related to higher education and research.
This feature vector represents adjectives modifying nouns to describe state, frequency, or certainty.
This vector represents Italian auxiliary and copular verb forms, particularly variants of "essere" (to be) and "avere" (to have).
This vector represents the concept of academic, scientific, or investigative research and inquiry across multiple languages.
